Election

Our department directs all municipal, state, and federal elections within Boston. As part of our work, we also register voters, conduct an annual census, and educate the public on voting.

Early Voting in Boston

Early voting for the 2026 State Election will take place on Saturday, October 17, through Friday, October 30.

Vote By Mail In Boston

If you are a registered voter in Boston, you can vote by mail in all 2026 elections.
